summary: Phase 8 (Tableau subtree) PARTIAL. Fixed Tableau/Defs.lean: temporalFormulaHash gained allFuture/allPast hash arms (tags 5/6); asAllFuture?/asAllPast? were WIP-authored against the OLD non-primitive Lukasiewicz encoding (imp (untl top (imp psi bot)) bot) which is no longer defeq to the primitive G/H constructors after Phase 1's promotion -- rewrote both to match the primitive constructor directly. lake build ...Tableau.Defs GREEN. Fixed Tableau/Rules.lean: temporalApplyPos_preserves/temporalApplyNeg_preserves/temporalApplyOne_preserves used `rcases <expr> with _ | y` on bare expressions (asAllFuture? sf.formula, asUntl? sf.formula, sf.sign) instead of hypotheses -- this only generalizes the goal target, never propagates into the already-computed hypothesis h, so every subsequent `simp only at h` silently made no progress (confirmed via lean_goal: goals_before == goals_after). This is a LATENT pre-existing bug in the WIP, not something introduced this dispatch -- the file was WIP-edited but never independently compiled (Preserved-Assets table: Verified=No). Replaced every such rcases with `split at h` (chained via `<;> try split at h` to fully unfold the case tree) plus `rename_i` to recover readable names, being careful that rename_i's 'last n inaccessible' count must also consume trailing heq/let-binder names, not just the formula binders. Two more unrelated latent bugs surfaced once elaboration reached them: List.mem_cons_self is argument-free in this Lean/Std version (WIP called it with two explicit underscores); simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton] left an unreduced `nf in []` residual for 2-branch RuleResult.branching results (needed List.not_mem_nil, or_false added). lake build ...Tableau.Rules GREEN, zero sorry, zero lint-style warnings (cleaned in-dispatch). Closure/Branch/Saturation/Soundness/TimeOrdering.lean all verify-only GREEN with zero edits (none pattern-match Formula constructors directly; all decomposition goes through the Defs.lean adapters). Tableau/Completeness.lean is BLOCKED and left untouched (PM5-compliant, no edits attempted): grep for allFuture/allPast returns zero matches in this file -- the 90 build errors are entirely confined to `private lemma temporalTruthLemma_propositional_aux` (lines 403-767, ~360 lines), a large PRE-EXISTING WIP proof (never independently compiled) about purely propositional (.imp/.atom/.bot) case analysis, unrelated to the G/H constructor promotion. Root cause: `simp only [temporalApplyOne, tryAllPropRules, ...] at hout` delta-unfolds definitions into hout BEFORE the subsequent `cases hφ'`/`cases hψ'` (which correctly substitute concrete subformula constructors, since hφ'/hψ' ARE genuine hypotheses) -- but the substitution does not force iota-reduction of the now-concrete nested match/if inside hout's already-unfolded type, leaving it frozen at every one of ~20 leaf branches. Fixing requires re-running the unfold/reduction AFTER each leaf's cases resolves concretely -- a ~20-site restructuring across 360 lines, not a small patch. Scoped as its own dedicated re-dispatch per PM1 (one phase per run) and the never-fake-green rule.

blockers.goal_text_example: leaf at :447 -- `have hfp := hout _ (by simp)` fails with `unsolved goals` because `hout`'s type is a frozen, un-iota-reduced nested match/if expression (from `simp only [temporalApplyOne, tryAllPropRules, applyPropRule, List.map, List.find?, tempAndOf?, tempOrOf?, tempImpOf?, tempNegOf?, RuleResult.isApplicable] at hout` run at :439-440, BEFORE `cases hφ'`/`cases hψ'` at :441+ substitute concrete subformula shapes). Representative later errors: `:457 Application type mismatch`, `:458 omega could not prove the goal`, `:520 rcases failed`.
blockers.root_cause: hout is unfolded via simp-delta before the case split that would let it iota-reduce further; every leaf needs a fresh reduction step after cases resolves phi'/psi' concretely, not just the one upfront simp call.
blockers.pre_existing: Yes -- WIP-authored, never independently compiled per plan's Preserved-Assets table (Tableau row: Verified=No).

continuation_context.notes: Re-dispatch Phase 8 (still [PARTIAL] in the plan) targeting ONLY Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Tableau/Completeness.lean. Do NOT touch Defs.lean/Rules.lean again (both scoped-green, verified, zero sorry, zero lint warnings -- PM5 preserved-work bar applies to them now too). Strategy: inside `temporalTruthLemma_propositional_aux` (:403-767), after each `cases hφ' with ... | cases hψ' with ...` leaf resolves concrete subformula constructors, re-run `simp only [temporalApplyOne, tryAllPropRules, applyPropRule, List.map, List.find?, tempAndOf?, tempOrOf?, tempImpOf?, tempNegOf?, RuleResult.isApplicable] at hout` (or find a tighter reduction, e.g. `dsimp only [...] at hout` or moving the have/simp for hout to occur AFTER the full case split rather than before) so `hout` actually collapses to the expected `∀ sf' ∈ newForms, ...` / `∃ br ∈ branches, ...` shape at each of the ~20 leaves before it's consumed via `have hfp := hout _ (by simp)` / `obtain ⟨br, hbr_mem, hbr⟩ := hout`. Use lean_goal liberally to inspect hout's exact frozen shape at each leaf before editing (as this dispatch did for Rules.lean). Once Completeness.lean is green: re-run the Phase 8 scoped gate `lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Tableau.Defs` and `lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Tableau.Soundness Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Tableau.Completeness`, flip Phase 8 to [COMPLETED] in the plan, and only then proceed to Phase 9 (Theorems.lean equivalence wrappers, Boudou2017 BibKey, downstream Bimodal/Foundations sweep, FULL CI -- this is the only phase that runs full `lake build`, PM2 build-exclusivity).
